name: Jasper Beryl
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Butler for the Idocrase family.

He comes to the human world along with Lapis to watch over her.
He usually calmly takes care of things, but he does have a strict side.
He used to work at the royal palace as an aide, but a few years ago he resigned and began working as a butler.
